### Law Abiding Citizen (2009) — Revenge, Justice & The Limits of the Law ⚖️

Law Abiding Citizen is a crime thriller starring Gerard Butler as Clyde Shelton, a brilliant man whose life is shattered when his wife and daughter are murdered during a home invasion. Devastated by the tragedy, Clyde watches as the justice system allows one of the criminals to receive a reduced sentence through a controversial deal made by prosecutor Nick Rice, played by Jamie Foxx.

Years later, Clyde begins carrying out a calculated campaign against everyone he believes failed his family. Even while imprisoned, he demonstrates an extraordinary ability to manipulate events and stay several steps ahead of the authorities. As the situation escalates, Nick must race to uncover Clyde's plan before more lives are lost.

The film explores revenge, corruption, morality, and the failures of the justice system. It raises difficult questions about whether justice can truly be served when legal procedures prioritize convictions over accountability.

What makes Law Abiding Citizen gripping is its intense psychological battle between two intelligent men with opposing views of justice. Every move challenges the boundaries between punishment and revenge, leaving viewers questioning who is truly in control.

💬 “When the system fails to deliver justice, revenge can become a dangerous obsession.”

source_details.synopsis: Law Abiding Citizen is a 2009 American vigilante action thriller film directed by F. Gary Gray and written by Kurt Wimmer. The film stars Jamie Foxx, Gerard Butler, Bruce McGill, Colm Meaney, Leslie Bibb, Regina Hall, Michael Irby, Christian Stolte, and Josh Stewart. Set in Philadelphia, it follows Clyde Shelton (Butler), a man who witnesses the rape and murder of his wife and daughter during a home invasion.
